title: The Wanderer's Reading Passport — Printable Reading Journal
description:
A reading journal disguised as a passport. Every book you finish is a journey: log it on a boarding pass, declare it at customs, and stamp a visa when it earns one.

What's inside (40 pages, PDF):
• Passport cover, holder's data page and reading regulations
• Travel log for the whole year and a world atlas to colour in the countries your books took you to
• 48 numbered boarding passes — title, author, departure and arrival dates, seat, rating
• Customs declarations for your favourite quotes and DNF books
• 6 visa pages plus 2 sheets of 24 printable visa stamps (genres, milestones, "DNF — deported")

Formats included: saddle-stitch booklet for A4 and US Letter (print double-sided, fold, staple — it becomes an A6/pocket passport), single pages in A6 and A5 for binders and tablets, and a one-page print guide.

Instant download: you get the link by email right after checkout. Digital product — nothing is shipped. English edition; a Spanish edition is available in the same listing.

title: Color the Fairy Tales — Walter Crane Coloring Book (Printed Paperback)
title_es: Colorea los cuentos de hadas — Libro para colorear de Walter Crane (tapa blanda impresa)
description:
A coloring book made from Walter Crane's picture books, printed in London between 1873 and 1876. Each of the 24 plates appears twice: on the left page in its original colors, on the right page as line art for you to color.

The stories: The Sleeping Beauty, Beauty and the Beast, The Frog Prince, Bluebeard, Little Red Riding Hood, Goody Two Shoes, The Hind in the Wood and The Yellow Dwarf.

The plates come from first editions scanned by Smithsonian Libraries and are in the public domain. We traced the line art from those scans with software, including a line-art model, and checked every page. The verse boxes on the coloring pages are left blank, so you can write in them or color them.

• Paperback, 8.5 × 11 in, 52 pages, printed in color
• 60# uncoated paper, which takes colored pencils well. Markers can show through to the back of the page.
• Printed to order by Lulu

Shipping to the United States is included. We ship to every country Lulu delivers to; for other countries the extra shipping cost is shown at checkout before you pay.

title: Audubon's Birds Vol. I, Red and Rose Birds: Color by Number Book (Printed Paperback)
title_es: Las aves de Audubon, vol. I, aves rojas y rosadas: libro para colorear por números (tapa blanda impresa)
description:
A color by number book made from eleven plates of John James Audubon's The Birds of America, printed in London between 1827 and 1838. Each picture is turned into a grid of 3,100 small squares, each with a number. Color every square with the color of its number and the bird appears.

The birds: American Flamingo, Scarlet Ibis, Northern Cardinal, Scarlet Tanager, Summer Tanager, Roseate Spoonbill, Reddish Egret, Redhead, Painted Bunting, Glossy Ibis and Pine Grosbeak.

Every bird is a spread. On the left page is the finished picture with its color key. On the right page is the numbered grid you color, so there is never a picture to color on the back of another. The lines and numbers are printed in light grey, so colored pencil covers them. White areas have no number and stay white.

The plates are in the public domain. We made the grids from them with our own software and checked every page. The book also has a page to try your pencils and three blank grids for designs of your own.

• Paperback, A4 (8.27 × 11.69 in), 32 pages, printed in color
• Squares of 3.5 mm, made for sharp colored pencils
• 60# uncoated paper. Markers can show through to the back of the page.
• Printed to order by Lulu

Shipping to the United States is included. We ship to every country Lulu delivers to; for other countries the extra shipping cost is shown at checkout before you pay.

title: The Jane Austen Puzzle Book: Word Searches, Cryptograms, Crosswords and Quotes (Printed Paperback)
title_es: The Jane Austen Puzzle Book: sopas de letras, criptogramas, crucigramas y citas (tapa blanda impresa)
description:
A puzzle book for readers of Jane Austen, with a chapter for each of her six novels: Pride and Prejudice, Emma, Sense and Sensibility, Persuasion, Northanger Abbey and Mansfield Park.

Each chapter has nine puzzles: two word searches, two cryptograms, a crossword, Who said it?, missing words, anagrams and a short quiz. That makes 54 puzzles, with all the solutions at the back.

Every quotation is taken from the original text of the novels and checked word for word. The cover drawing is by Hugh Thomson, from the 1894 edition of Pride and Prejudice. The novels and the drawing are in the public domain; the puzzles, clues and layout are our own.

• Paperback, 8.5 × 11 in, 76 pages, black and white inside, color cover
• In English
• Printed to order by Lulu

Shipping to the United States is included. We ship to every country Lulu delivers to; for other countries the extra shipping cost is shown at checkout before you pay.
